facts.fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde page states that payment services and the issue, distribution and redemption of electronic money are regulated by Decreto-legislativo n.º 8/2018 of 28 November 2018.

The page states that access to the activity of payment institutions and e-money institutions is regulated by Decreto-legislativo n.º 9/2018 of 28 November 2018, with parts set out in BCV Aviso n.º 6/2019 on authorisation, minimum capital, own funds and safeguarding of funds.

The page states that payment institutions and e-money institutions, financial institutions distinct from banks, are authorised by the Banco de Cabo Verde under Decreto-legislativo n.º 9/2018, and that Correios de Cabo Verde may also issue e-money; it names no licensee and gives the page date 2025-01-01 only as its published date.
